title: rung 3 of the six-rung selection rule compares the supported-claim rate, not a raw count
amends: rung 3 as declared in docs/HANDOVER_BENCHMARK_PLAN_V2.md section 6 and implemented in scripts/select_condition.py
rule: Rung 3 compares cells on the rate of knowledge-base-validated mechanism claims, computed as supported claims divided by marked claims in the hand-marked sheet produced by scripts/mechanism_sheet.py, with the number of marked claims and the number of distinct source items reported beside every rate. A cell enters rung 3 only if at least 15 of its sentences are marked and those sentences come from at least 10 distinct items; a cell below either floor is excluded from the rung and the exclusion is written into the receipt. Two cells are adjudicated only when their exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95 per cent intervals do not overlap; when the intervals overlap, no cell is chosen at rung 3, the overlap is recorded, and selection proceeds to rung 4. Rung 3 never compares a raw count of supported claims, never borrows a claim count from another condition, and never pads a cell to reach a floor. If fewer than two eligible cells exist at run time, rungs 2 and 3 are recorded as unavailable and the rule proceeds to rung 4.
attestation: I signed this before any mechanism-validity comparison and before any six-cell condition table existed. The only report-surface reading on record is the 40-row D30 sheet, which carries none of the claim counts this amendment governs.

refuses: a bare scalar in place of an entry
an entry missing supported, marked or items
a non-integer, negative, or supported > marked count
implementation.interval: exact Clopper-Pearson, 95 per cent, computed per cell
implementation.tie_handling: the best point estimate keeps every cell whose interval overlaps its own; a single survivor decides rung 3, otherwise the overlap is recorded and rung 4 runs
implementation.unavailable_handling: fewer than two eligible cells records rungs 2 and 3 as unavailable and proceeds to rung 4

consequences: a rung-3 decision is a measured win and leaves the receipt non-provisional
an overlapping comparison cannot ship a cell at rung 3 in either direction
a rung-6-only outcome stays provisional and cannot carry the confirmatory pass
no mechanism claim may be quoted as a selection result unless rung 3 decided
does_not_change: the D29 disposition or the D30 frozen reading
any number in handover sections 16 to 22
